parameters.name: AclId
parameters.description: The ID of the associated access control policy group.

parameters.name: AclStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable access control. Valid values:
- **on**: Enabled.
- **off**: Disabled.

parameters.name: AclType
parameters.description:
The type of access control:

- **white**: Allows the IPv6 addresses in the access control policy group to access backend services.

- **black**: Denies the IPv6 addresses in the access control policy group from accessing backend services.

parameters.name: AllocateIpv6Port
parameters.description: The port used by the IPv6 address allocated by the IPv6 Translation Service instance.

parameters.name: BackendIpv4Addr
parameters.description: The public IPv4 address that requires IPv6 services (the IPv4 address of the IPv4-only server).

parameters.name: BackendIpv4Port
parameters.description: The port of the public IPv4 address that requires IPv6 services.

parameters.name: EntryBandwidth
parameters.description:
The peak bandwidth of the IPv6 translation mapping entry. Valid values: 
        
- -1 (default): No bandwidth limit is imposed on the IPv6 translation mapping entry.  
- 1-200Mbps: The bandwidth value of the mapping entry.            

> The sum of peak bandwidth values of all IPv6 translation mapping entries cannot exceed the peak bandwidth of the instance.

parameters.name: EntryDescription
parameters.description: The description of the IPv6 translation mapping entry.

parameters.name: EntryName
parameters.description: The name of the IPv6 translation mapping entry. The name must be 2 to 100 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: Ipv6TranslatorId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the IPv6 Translation Service.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. You can call the **DescribeRegions** operation to query region IDs.

parameters.name: TransProtocol
parameters.description:
The protocol type. Valid values:

- **tcp**: Forwards TCP packets.  
- **udp**: Forwards UDP packets.
